annotations.pda_responsibility: any damage to that siding is on me

annotations.pda_responsibility: that happened because I chose to act

annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I go along with it when it keeps me out of trouble

annotations.pda_responsibility: it went wrong through my hand, nobody else's
annotations.pda_repair_intention: report myself to the railway, explain everything, and pay

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Some damage and disruption against five lives
annotations.pda_responsibility: I made that call and I knew what the lever did
annotations.pda_repair_intention: own up, and ask how to put right whatever I messed up
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I stay off the tracks and away from equipment because getting caught is expensive

annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: No one's in danger from the switch, and five people are in danger without it
annotations.pda_responsibility: Tampering is tampering, and I chose to do it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: offer to pay for the barrier or any delays
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I keep to the rules around trains mostly because it's cheaper

annotations.pda_responsibility: I'm the person who caused it
annotations.pda_repair_intention: explain to the staff what happened, and sign whatever statement
annotations.sys_instrumental_norm_use: I respect that only as long as it protects me
